_comment: PR 12 pump-trace acceptance fixture — the TARGET-BEARING ack-carrier branch (the cursor-free branch is record-smoke.timeline.json). Same self-contained fixture .alo and spawner events as record-smoke, plus a target-bearing cursor track using POINT targets only: point targets classify the run target-bearing (so the pump posts ui/cursor-tick per frame BEFORE the at-events and reads the per-frame ackData) yet always resolve without a DOM lookup, so there is no exit-3 resolution fragility. Not a gate lane — driven manually with PE_RECORD_TRACE=1 to byte-compare the pump-trace across the RecordSession extraction. No press frames (kept out of the resolve-or-die path on purpose).
